llm_response.reason: The website presents a highly suspicious mix of characteristics: (1) it offers an exceptionally wide range of unrelated goods at unusually low prices; (2) uses urgency and psychological sales tactics; (3) provides suspicious and non-corporate contact details/email; (4) gives vague business info with a reused address; (5) has no web search footprint or legitimate reviews; (6) lacks basic web navigation and hyperlinks, which is not normal for e-commerce. These are classic signs of a fake online shopping scam.
